data.title: 红月卡莲 · 晨光微澜的红被初醒伸展
data.description: 学园宿舍明朗的清晨，初阳透过窗纱洒在纯白被褥上。卡莲侧坐在床榻上伸展着充满健美线条的双臂，红色真丝吊带裙贴身勾勒出紧致挺拔的腰肢与优美曲线。红发在阳光下散发着金红的光芒，她揉了揉微红的眼角，向你展露出毫无战场戾气的纯洁笑颜，洋溢着少女独有的青春与依恋。
data.action: sitting on white bed stretching arms overhead, crimson silk camisole, bare toned midriff and collarbone, morning sunlight illuminating red hair, bright blushing smile
data.location: peaceful sunlit student dorm bedroom in early morning
data.lighting: pure bright morning sunlight pouring into the room
data.mood: athletic healthy domestic bliss, radiant morning affection
data.promptProse: Stretching her arms overhead on a sunlit bed, Kallen wears a sleek crimson camisole. Morning sunbeams illuminate her toned shoulders and messy red hair as she greets the day with a bright, blushing smile.
data.animaCaption: Kallen stretching on a sunlit bed in a crimson camisole with a bright, blushing smile.
